observations: Barbarian Training is a 2024-era miniquest with independently orderable Fishing, Firemaking, Farming, Smithing and Herblore tracks.
Heavy rod fishing needs 48 Fishing, 15 Agility/Strength, a barbarian rod and bait; barehand tuna requires 55 boostable Fishing and 35 Strength.
Bow firemaking requires 35 unboostable Firemaking and unlocks the Ancient Cavern whirlpool before obtaining chewed bones from mithril dragons.
A pyre ship uses logs, tinderbox or bow, axe and chewed bones; chewed bones are RNG, modeled as one successful extended dragon-fighting planned outcome.
Barbarian Farming has separate no-dibber sowing and sapling-pot-smashing phases; an empty patch and the seed type affect materials/XP.
Barbarian smithing requires completed Tai Bwo Wannai Trio and specifically Tamayu's optional combat XP claim, in addition to Otto's rod fishing training.
Herblore uses a 2-dose attack potion and roe from leaping trout to create one attack mix, with 4 Herblore and Druidic Ritual completion.
Into the Tombs requires Beneath Cursed Sands and completion of one full entry-mode Tombs of Amascut raid, not only an NPC conversation.
Apmeken/Ba-Ba, Crondis/Zebak, Het/Akkha and Scabaras/Kephri paths can occur in any order, then the Wardens and reward room unlock.
Only after the raid should Maisa grant a retained 50,000-XP antique lamp for one combat skill at base level 60+, excluding Prayer.
pending_reviews: Spear training checks Tamayu's separate post-quest combat training claim from Tai Bwo Wannai Trio.
Barbarian rod and seed successes have randomness; actual incidental Fishing/Strength/Agility/Cooking/Farming XP, failed gutting, seed failure and resource consumption need field calibration.
Mithril dragons drop chewed bones infrequently; estimated 42 kills and all associated combat costs, dragonfire, food/prayer use and death recovery are provisional.
The Ancient Cavern one-way whirlpool and aged-log escape are modeled, but exact exits, floors, path lengths and hazards must be verified.
The free tree patch and allotment are scenario assumptions; alternate farming patches and clearing with axe or 200 GP are not enumerated.
The Ancient Cavern unlock on Otto bow report may occur after the subsequent pyre-ship dialogue; in-game gating should be tested.
Tombs of Amascut raid rooms are approximate instance coordinates. Path puzzle solutions, combat loads, consumable supplies, party size and invocation selection need detailed strategy data.
Entry-mode raid loot is random and repeatable and intentionally not credited; completing Into the Tombs unlocks future raids and the separate ancient-key path.
The 50,000 XP lamp's physical retention, banking, destroy/reclaim mechanics and exact skill level boundary require confirmation; 60+ is modeled.
Client completion flag might post upon Maisa dialogue while an unclaimed lamp is still in inventory; integration needs a real game-state replay.
